author: LadyLeigh
name: Check
short: Audit command permissions and installed repository/cog status.
description: Bot-owner-only command access and repository inventory reports. Flags custom checks, unloaded cogs, hidden commands and repos with no tracked cogs or shared libraries for review.
install_msg: Load check, then run [p]checkcommands for access requirements or [p]checkrepos for repository cleanup review.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not persistently store user data.
